bio: I'm a California-based security engineer focused on threat detection, SIEM monitoring, and incident triage. I'm pursuing my Master's in Cybersecurity at WGU (started Apr 2026, ~41% credited at entry from prior learning) and building hands-on experience through Wazuh, Okta-focused detection work, Azure and Terraform labs, phishing analysis, and automation. I love camping, mountain biking, and spending time with my dogs.
targetRoles: Target roles: SOC Analyst, Detection Engineering, Security Operations, IT Security Specialist, security-focused IT Support.

experience.title: MS Cybersecurity Student
experience.description: MS program aligned to security operations and defense. Coursework and labs emphasize Wazuh SIEM investigations, Tier 1–style alert triage and documentation, Windows/Linux log review, and reducing noisy detections. Complemented by independent work in Okta-centric detection logic, Azure hardening with Terraform, and cloud security auditing. Studying part-time while working full-time toward a SOC or detection role.

experience.title: Hands-on security labs (Wazuh, Okta, Azure)

SOAR-style orchestration and network behavioral analysis round out the blue-team stack. Code and write-ups are public on GitHub (see My Projects).
